mechanism: Phenobarbital induces CYP450 enzymes (primarily CYP2C9, CYP3A4), reducing oxacillin metabolism and potentially decreasing antibiotic efficacy; oxacillin may also increase phenobarbital metabolism.
action: Monitor clinical response to oxacillin therapy; consider alternative antibiotic or increased oxacillin dosing if needed; monitor phenobarbital levels as oxacillin may reduce its concentration.
